decisions.reason: The encrypted communication channel remains a low-cost, core-adjacent option whose strategic uncertainty is not fully resolved, so it is worth keeping open.
Mobile PDF signing is close to the firm's authentication know-how and may still benefit from regulatory trends, making it a cheap option to hold despite limited visibility.
The email-to-app robot is peripheral and has higher keeping costs, and after four years without website presence its option value is unlikely to be realized.
QR hardware tokens carry inventory and support costs, and with no observed traction the option no longer justifies continued holding.
Payment security compliance remains strategically valuable and cheap to keep as a regulatory option, despite limited market visibility.
